springs.title: The Regenerative Practitioner, Lisbon cohort
springs.where: Online, with a three-day intensive at Gandum Village, near Lisbon
springs.text: Learn regenerative development by working with a real project, alongside practitioners from many places and fields. Open to people anywhere, with a special welcome for Europe and Portugal. Co-taught by Nuno da Silva and Constança Belchior of Lucida. Sliding-scale discounts and scholarships are offered.
springs.costNote: Paid, with sliding scale and scholarships
springs.found: Shared by Jyo, from the Regenesis newsletter
